segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or normal/dry skin describe the product as hydrating without extra moisturizer needed, though one dry-skin reviewer notes it may suit even oilier types.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts, with one exception describing eye stinging or burning with use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 50s-70s report a smoothing, hydrating effect and say it does not worsen fine lines or wrinkles.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes it works over combination/normal skin without pilling or excess shine, though the finish can be shiny for some.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers (including a 74-year-old and a 51-year-old) report the product smooths skin, fills in the look of pores and wrinkles, and does not exacerbate fine lines; one 38-year-old reports a more youthful look.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry skin, report a hydrating, dewy finish with no need for additional moisturizer; two reviewers with foundation layered on top say they cannot really tell it is moisturizing.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea and general redness report the tint blurs redness and causes no irritation, with one reviewer describing burning/stinging in the eyes as an exception.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with circumoral dermatitis from mask-wearing reports no irritation from the product.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with post-acne marks says the product does not fully even out discoloration on its own and mixes in tinted moisturizer to camouflage it; another says it does not cover blemishes.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports no breakouts and calls it non-clogging; another says it is good for covering blemishes and evening skin tone, while a third notes it does not cover blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says the finish can be shiny and not recommended for everyday wear, while others describe it as non-greasy and lightweight.

extraits.titre: i cannot believe how well this worked for me!
extraits.texte: I am SHOCKED that this went so well for me. I was fortunate to receive this complimentary from MDSolarSciences, but upon receiving it, I panicked over the filters used. However, my skin...did great with this? I am very sensitive, so I am exceedingly pleased to be typing that!Now, I will tell you some honest pros and cons, that are a bit wrapped up into one with this product. First, it claims to give a glow, and wow - it DOES. It's a gorgeous product with no glitter, but it looks stunning on. Like you have a natural radiance to your skin. However! It's got a universal tint. Ayyy! I have a very fair skin tone, so it looked a bit off on me. It worked great as a primer though, so I added a lighter concealer to the center of my face, then set with powder. The end look was perfect.Basically: if it's a perfect match for your skin (i'm going to say NC 20ish?), you can slap this on and go, and your skin will look phenomenal and be protected from the sun. If you are more fair, or more deep I suspect, you may need to add a bit of makeup on top. But yes, it's friendly towards makeup.Not drying, not uncomfortable, no stinging. Frankly I am blown away by how easy it was to wear.5 stars, I would definitely recommend this product!

The product provide a light glow and non greasy look. I've used as top layer over my face moisturizer. It doesn't cover blemishes but is perfect for an everyday running errands sun shield look. I'm most surprised about the soft texture and no white cast on my melanated face. Lastly, my skin is SENSITIVE and all the MD products have been gentle non clogging‚no breakouts here!!!

Finally, a tinted glowy sunscreen I can use. I have fair skin, and almost all of the tinted sunscreens out there are too dark or orange on me. This isn't. The formula is great. It's easy to apply, makes your skin looks healthy but not overly dewy, and slightly evens your complexion. Great for my dry skin but I think even oilier skin types might enjoy it.

Beautiful sunscreen, moisturizer, and tint for no makeup days. Makes my dry, red, 51 year old skin look beautiful, natural, and glowy. Been using this for at least three years and I continue to absolutely love this product every year. Finished at least two tubes and have three more on standby. Just perfect for me.
I have super sensitive, mature skin, and everything that I've tried is either heavy, greasy or just feels gross on my skin. Glen +Glow is the best sunscreen for my face and I'm absolutely in love!
